message.reasoning: We need to answer: earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record. Likely earliest non-Christian references: Josephus (Antiquities 18.3), Tacitus (Annals 15.44), Pliny the Younger (letters). Also maybe the earliest Christian references: the Gospels (written ~70-90 CE). But question: "earliest reference of Jesus Christ in history from historical record?" So likely earliest mention outside Christian texts: Josephus, 1st century. So answer: Josephus' Antiquities of the Jews, Book 18, Chapter 3, written around 93-94 CE. Also Tacitus wrote about Christ in 116 CE. So earliest is Josephus. Provide details. Also mention that some scholars debate authenticity of the passage. Provide context. Also mention that earliest Christian references are the Gospels. Provide citations. Use function? The user asked for earliest reference from historical record. We can use get_earliest_reference function to confirm. Let's call get_earliest_reference with name "Jesus Christ" and source "historical records".
